questions.title: Comprehensive Unit Testing Strategy
questions.question: Design a comprehensive unit testing strategy for a complex service class with multiple dependencies, async operations, and error handling. How do you balance test coverage, test speed, and maintainability?
questions.realWorldScenario: You have a PaymentService class with dependencies on PaymentGateway (external API), FraudDetectionService (ML model), NotificationService (async), AuditLogger, and TransactionRepository (database). The service handles payment processing with retry logic, fraud checks, notifications, and comprehensive error handling. Design a unit testing strategy covering: 1) Dependency isolation approach, 2) Testing happy path and error scenarios, 3) Testing retry logic and timeouts, 4) Testing async notifications, 5) Verifying audit logging, 6) Testing exception handling and recovery, 7) Ensuring fast test execution, 8) Maintaining test readability and maintainability. Include specific examples of test structure, mocking strategy, and assertion approaches.
